scope_deviations.operation: Product implementation edit before completed red E2E result
scope_deviations.why_nonconformant: The executor launched the red E2E as a background task and edited product implementation before that task completed. The eventual failing E2E output was concurrent with the edit and therefore cannot prove a completed red run against unchanged @1 behavior.

scope_deviations.operation: Active reads of tool-internal background-task output
scope_deviations.why_nonconformant: The frozen contract allowed unavoidable tool-internal state only when the executor did not select, inspect, copy, cite or reuse it. Both grep commands selected and inspected that file as a result channel.

scope_deviations.operation: Piped Node red-test output without pipefail
scope_deviations.why_nonconformant: The frozen contract permitted a stdout pipe for large output only with pipefail. These commands merged stderr and piped output without setting pipefail, so their shell exit status did not reliably witness the test failure.

unit_suite.interpretation: Expected unit red behavior was observed before the first product implementation edit, but several display commands used a pipe without pipefail.

visual_e2e_suite.interpretation: The suite ultimately failed as expected, but it ran in the background concurrently with the first product implementation edit and is not accepted as valid red-before evidence.

termination.reason: Fail-closed enforcement of test-first ordering and forbidden tool-internal ephemeral inspection stop conditions
termination.process_cleanup: Exact shell, gtimeout, tee and kimi-code PIDs received SIGTERM and were verified absent
termination.dirty_worktree_policy: Preserve the isolated failed worktree for audit; never continue it or promote its diff

recommended_retry.minimum_prompt_delta: All red tests must run synchronously and return non-zero before any product implementation edit. Background test execution and reading any tool-internal task output path are forbidden. Every stdout test pipe must begin in a shell with pipefail, but direct unpiped test execution is preferred.
